integrity: All group characters are induced by geometric vertex permutations with oriented simplicial chains; published nonequivariant results are explicitly credited. Scientific review is a same-model review and not an independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Only the rational D4-module is classified; no integral representation splitting or equivariant homotopy equivalence is asserted.
Previously published square-grid shellability, homotopy concentration, and ordinary Betti formula are used as premises and are not claimed as new.
Direct exhaustive chain-supertrace checks cover n=3 and n=4; larger finite orders corroborate signed local enumerations but do not substitute for the symbolic proof.
Possible unindexed earlier equivalent character computations remain a bibliographic risk.
title: The \(D_4\)-character of square-grid three-cut homology
